mechanism: Adalimumab (TNF-alpha inhibitor) may increase infection risk and potentially worsen neuropsychiatric adverse effects; deutetrabenazine carries inherent risk of depression and suicidality that could be compounded by immunosuppression.
action: Monitor closely for signs of infection, depression, and suicidal ideation; ensure baseline psychiatric assessment before initiating deutetrabenazine in patients on adalimumab.
